bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; q(){ docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atqc "$1" 2>/dev/null; }; a=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(49,104) t(id) LEFT JOIN posting_topics p ON p.message_thread_id=t.id AND p.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND p.board_key='area_bbs' AND p.purpose='announcement' AND p.enabled=TRUE AND p.verified_at IS NOT NULL WHERE p.topic_id IS NULL") || exit 71; b=$(q "SELECT count(*) FROM generate_series(49,104) t(id) LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.message_thread_id=t.id AND p.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND p.state='published' AND p.pinned=TRUE AND p.message_id>0 WHERE p.message_thread_id IS NULL") || exit 72; test "$a" -le 9 && test "$b" -le 9 || exit 73; exit $((100+10*a+b))
